headline: How an Immigration Consultancy Scaled to ~95 Google Ads Leads a Month
summary_line: PPC Guru launched an immigration consultancy on Google Ads in September 2025 and, on a flat budget of around $760 a month, scaled it from 55 genuine leads in its first month to roughly 95 a month in the most recent quarter (Apr–Jun 2026) — at a cost per lead of about $8, driven mainly by high-intent phone calls.
client_context: The client is an immigration consultancy based in Toronto, Canada, helping individuals and families with visa, residency and immigration applications. Its enquiries are overwhelmingly phone calls from people actively researching their options — a high-intent, time-sensitive service where speaking to a consultant quickly matters. Google Ads is the firm's primary channel for reaching those searchers at the moment they need help.
background: The consultancy came to PPC Guru to build its paid-search presence from scratch. The account launched in September 2025 with a modest budget of around $720 a month, combining a Search campaign for high-intent immigration queries with a Performance Max campaign to extend reach. The goal from the outset was straightforward: a steady, affordable flow of genuine enquiries — mostly phone calls — from people ready to talk.
analysis: PPC Guru set the account up around genuine lead measurement — call tracking plus lead-form submissions — so that from launch the numbers reflected real enquiries rather than button taps or Business Profile actions. A Search campaign captured the highest-intent immigration searches, while Performance Max broadened reach; the ongoing work was to concentrate spend on what converted and let cost per lead fall as the data matured.
analysis_points: Launch a Search campaign for high-intent immigration queries plus a Performance Max campaign for reach.
Track genuine phone calls and lead-form submissions, separating them from Google local actions and pop-up clicks.
Use Maximize Conversions bidding and concentrate budget on the searches that produced real enquiries.
Grow lead volume on a flat budget by improving conversion rate and cost per lead.

timeline.what: Launch month — 55 genuine leads at about $13 each, on a ~$720 budget.
First full quarter — about 179 genuine leads (roughly 60 a month) as the account settled in.
Scaled to about 291 genuine leads (roughly 97 a month) on the same flat budget.
About 95 genuine leads a month at roughly $8 each.

challenge: Launching a brand-new account in a competitive, high-value category like immigration means starting with no conversion history and keeping cost per lead low enough for a modest budget to work hard. Early clicks needed to be converted into genuine phone calls efficiently, and the reporting had to stay honest — the account also records plenty of Google local actions and pop-up clicks that can flatter the numbers if they are counted as leads.

changes.why: A Search campaign captured high-intent immigration queries while Performance Max extended reach across Google's inventory.
Measured real phone calls and lead-form submissions, keeping Google local actions and pop-up clicks out of the lead count.
With clean lead signals, automated bidding pushed cost per lead down as volume grew.
Spend was steered toward the searches and placements that produced genuine enquiries.

changes.change: Grew volume on a flat budget
changes.why: Leads nearly doubled from launch while monthly spend stayed near $760 — the gains came from efficiency.

benchmark: All figures are genuine phone-call and lead-form conversions. From April 2026 the account's all-conversions total is heavily inflated by Google local actions and pop-up/button clicks (for example, one month recorded 84 genuine leads against nearly 490 total actions); those non-lead actions are excluded so the counts reflect real enquiries. Because budget stayed near $760 a month, the growth in leads and the fall in cost per lead reflect improving efficiency rather than extra spend.

early_stage.title: The First Quarter
early_stage.intro: The account produced genuine leads from its very first month and grew steadily as the campaigns gathered data. Cost per lead was already low at launch and edged lower as conversion rate improved.

gradual: From a solid launch the account climbed month over month. It averaged about 60 genuine leads a month in its first full quarter (Q4 2025), then stepped up to roughly 95–97 a month across Q1 and Q2 2026 — peaking near 124 in April — all on the same modest budget. The monthly trend below shows a genuine growth curve with the normal variation of a live account, not a one-off spike.

spotlight.title: Keeping the Lead Count Honest
spotlight.body: Immigration accounts attract a lot of low-value signals — Google Maps directions, Business Profile taps and on-site pop-up clicks — that can make results look far bigger than they are. This account is measured on genuine phone calls and lead-form submissions only. That discipline is why the reported ~95 leads a month is a number the consultancy can trust: each one is a real enquiry, not a button click, and it keeps bidding optimising toward people who actually pick up the phone.

lessons: A modest budget can produce strong volume in a high-intent category if cost per lead is kept low from day one.
Count genuine calls and form submissions only — Maps directions and pop-up clicks flatter the numbers without adding enquiries.
Pair a focused Search campaign with Performance Max to capture intent and extend reach.
For time-sensitive services like immigration, phone calls are the highest-value action — optimise toward them.
Growth doesn't have to mean a bigger budget; a better conversion rate does the same job.
why_it_worked: Genuine call and form tracking kept the account optimising toward real enquiries from launch.
A Search plus Performance Max structure captured high intent while extending reach.
Cost per lead stayed low and improved as conversion rate climbed.
Lead volume nearly doubled on a flat budget — the gains came from efficiency.
outcome: Less than a year after launch, the consultancy runs a dependable Google Ads program generating about 95 genuine leads a month — the large majority high-intent phone calls — at roughly $8 each in the most recent complete quarter (April–June 2026). That is up from 55 leads at about $13 each in its first month, on essentially the same budget. With honest call-and-form measurement in place, the firm has a scalable, affordable channel it can grow with confidence.
cta: PPC Guru helps Canadian consultancies turn search demand into genuine phone-call enquiries with conversion-focused Google Ads and transparent reporting.
methodology: All figures are pulled directly from the client's Google Ads account and shown on a monthly basis. 'Leads' are genuine phone calls and lead-form submissions only; Google local actions, pop-up clicks and other non-enquiry actions are excluded. 'Then' is the first complete month under management (September 2025); 'Now' is the most recent complete quarter (April–June 2026). The account has an eleven-month history, so confidence is rated medium.
lead_quality: The large majority of genuine leads are direct phone calls — the highest-intent action for a time-sensitive service like immigration — with a small number of website lead-form submissions.
